name: The Portage Bar at The Riverhead

dishes.excerpt: Classic Sunday roast with rotating meat option or vegan nut roast served with veges, gravy, and Yorkshire pudding.

notes: Official site lists this as a Sunday special; menu is seasonal and the meat option rotates. It describes the nut roast as vegan but does not separately label the accompaniments.

dishes.excerpt: Crispy Potato Rösti (GF/VG); menu legend defines GF as gluten-free and VG as vegan.

dishes.name: Balsamic Glazed Wild Mushrooms
dishes.excerpt: Balsamic Glazed Wild Mushrooms (VG); menu legend defines VG as vegan.

name: Brazilian Cafe & Bistro
address: 321 Oteha Valley Extension, Albany, Auckland (inside Albany Tennis Park)

dishes.name: Vegan Stroganoff
dishes.excerpt: Young jackfruit, mushroom, carrot, coconut cream, fresh herbs and seasoning; served with fries and salad.

notes: The official menu names the item Vegan Stroganoff; it does not give the dish a gluten-free label.

name: Westie Bistro

dishes.name: Crispy Cauli-Broccoli
dishes.excerpt: Crispy Cauli-Broccoli (V) (VGN) (GF); the menu defines VGN as vegan and GF as gluten-free.

notes: The official site currently links to its menu, but the retrieved dinner PDF is dated September 2024; confirm the item remains available. Menu says it is served with a choice of Sticky Asian Sauce or Spicy Volcano.

name: The Franklin Taphouse & Kitchen

dishes.name: Vegan Poke Bowl
dishes.excerpt: Vegan Poke Bowl (V, VGN): Asian-style fried rice, broccoli, mushrooms, burnt garlic, tempura cauliflower, edamame, guacamole, kimchi, chilli oil and spring onion.

notes: Current official menu legend defines VGN as vegan; this dish is not labelled gluten-free.

name: The Matakana Pub

dishes.name: Warm Roast Vege Salad
dishes.excerpt: Warm Roast Vege Salad (gf, vg, v): seasonal roasted vegetables with almond and cashew dressing.

notes: Official menu labels this salad GF and VG; the site's menu uses icon labels for dietary claims.

name: Prego

dishes.name: Vegan Margherita Pizza
dishes.excerpt: Vegan menu lists Margherita with dairy- and nut-free cheese; its pizza section says a gluten-free base is available on request.

dishes.name: Vegan Funghi Pizza
dishes.excerpt: Vegan menu lists Funghi with dairy- and nut-free cheese; its pizza section says a gluten-free base is available on request.

notes: Official vegan menu is dated March 2026. The GF base is a requested option; Prego says it cannot guarantee that food is completely free from gluten traces.

name: Queen's Head Bar & Eatery
address: Four Points by Sheraton Auckland, 396 Queen Street, Auckland 1010

dishes.name: Mr. Hou’s Vegetable Dumpling
dishes.excerpt: Mr. Hou’s Vegetable Dumpling (vg), with crispy shallot, red chilli oil, soya and sesame seeds; menu legend defines vg as vegan.

notes: The all-day menu says it changes every six weeks; listed dish was present in the retrieved current menu.

name: The Alderman

dishes.name: Granola
dishes.excerpt: Granola with mango coconut chia and berry compote (vegan).

notes: The Alderman identifies itself as a licensed West Auckland café; the menu lists the granola as vegan.

name: Kings Garden Cafe Henderson

dishes.name: Vegan Bowl
dishes.excerpt: Plant-based menu lists Vegan Bowl with kumara and corn bites, roasted carrots, beetroot hummus, avocado, fresh tomato and cucumber, gherkin, tomato relish, chickpea salad and toasted seeds.

dishes.name: Açai Bowl
dishes.excerpt: Plant-based menu lists an açai bowl with berry smoothie base, banana, peanut butter and gluten-free granola, berry compote, mango and coconut yoghurt.

notes: The cafe says the listed items are under its Plant-Based Menu heading; the açai bowl names gluten-free granola in that same section. The venue also advertises a dedicated kids' area, but not high-chair availability.

name: Thaiger

dishes.name: Tofu Satay Stir Fry
dishes.excerpt: Listed under VEGAN: seasonal vegetables and organic tofu stir-fried in vegan satay sauce; menu marks it GF.

dishes.excerpt: Listed under VEGAN: cauliflower rice with sautéed tofu, curry spices, beansprouts, spring onion and vegetables; menu marks it GF.
